premises.text: About a billion existing remote/window/split air conditioners cannot be made smart by products like Nest thermostats
premises.evidence_span: All I could find is smart thermostats like Nest. But I had this air conditioner in my home, and there are one billion of these kinds of air conditioners all around the world

premises.text: A Sensible pod connects those air conditioners to an app and automates efficient climate control that cuts energy use
premises.evidence_span: We make any air conditioner smart

premises.text: Basic kit is about $160 plus about $80 per additional AC via site pre-orders
premises.evidence_span: The first kit, the basic kit for Sensible costs $160, and then for each additional air conditioner you have in your home or office, it's another $80

value.text: Comfortable automatic AC control that lowers energy bills and emissions
value.evidence_span: we want the world to be greener to reduce co2 emissions and of course to affect your electricity bill

causal_links.evidence_span: the only logical conclusion was to build a product that connects to the air conditioner
